sources.provider: Purdue University GIS / ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 0
sources.role: Current named polygon and building attributes; FID 797, UC, University Church, 320 North Street, owner PURDUE.
sources.limits: 20-point exterior ring is a campus GIS footprint, not wall survey or facade map. Fields Level_=4, NUM_LEVELS=1, CountOfFLO=3, Extrution=39 conflict or lack documented units; use no attribute as measured elevation.

sources.role: One-page first-floor room/wayfinding schematic, title UNIVERSITY CHURCH, first floor; consistent building identity and connected teaching-space layout.
sources.limits: No north arrow, scale, dimensions, wall types, elevation, room-to-facade schedule, or roof information. The large UC114 fill obscures a substantial area; symbols are room/wayfinding content, not verified exterior doors.

sources.provider: Indiana Commission for Higher Education, Capital Projects for Expedited Action, March 14, 2019
sources.role: Purchase request identifies University Church at 320 North Street as a long-term potential new-building location, while describing near-term potential academic/administrative use.
sources.limits: Purchase authorization request is not evidence of the completion date, demolition, or current exterior alteration.

sources.provider: Indiana State Budget Committee, June 2019 meeting minutes
sources.role: Records the acquired 320 North Street facility as 31,964 square feet / 0.86 acre and multi-story; source of size and broad height-class context.
sources.limits: Administrative purchase record, not measured elevations or exact storey count. It confirms a multi-story facility only.

sources.provider: Indiana Commission for Higher Education, November 2023 Commission Agenda, p.29 (PDF p.30)
sources.role: Names University Church purchase as a 2019 comparable (0.86 acre, 32,000 GSF) and states it remains standing and is used for university classroom space.
sources.limits: Confirms status at the 2023 agenda date only; does not establish that all conditions remain unchanged in 2026 or that future demolition/construction will not occur.

sources.role: Primary photographic exterior view: near-portico oblique including front, long flank, tower and lower attached wing. Red brick, pale four-column classical portico, triangular pediment/oculus, steps, square tower and green copper spire, arched side windows and lower dark roof.
sources.limits: Single dusk photograph; no geotag or camera azimuth/height. Perspective and deep shade hide exact opening counts, other faces and junction details; colors are photographic, uncalibrated estimates.

sources.provider: Home of Purdue / Visit Lafayette listing snapshot (audit retrieval 2026-10-26)
sources.role: Reconciliation/negative match: image shows a large red-brick church with twin towers and Gothic arches.
sources.limits: The retained listing HTML identifies its image address as 411 N. 7th St, Lafayette, not the listing text’s University Church at West Lafayette. Therefore it is excluded from all target-building facade inference; it is not an opposing view or historic phase.

sources.role: Official index labels UC / University Church, grid I7; site orientation/context cross-check.
sources.limits: Campus map is diagrammatic and no individual building facade detail.
